profiles.title: Imirondoro y’abatanga
profiles.description: Indangamuntu z’amategeko utangiraho fagitire. Iyisanzwe yuzuza fagitire nshya.

profiles.archiveDescription: Ivanwa mu myanya yo guhitamo; fagitire zisanzweho ntizihinduka.

new.title: Umwirondoro mushya w’utanga
new.prefilled: Byujujwe uhereye ku bisubizo byawe; genzura aderesi n’amakuru y’imisoro, hanyuma ubike.

edit.deleteDescription: Bishoboka gusa nta fagitire cyangwa inoti y’inguzanyo ihuriye n’uyu mwirondoro. Bitabaye ibyo, uwubike mu bubiko.

template.usingInstanceDescription: Inyandiko z’uyu mwirondoro zikurikiza Igenamiterere → Inyandikorugero. Hitamo kuzihindura ukwazo.
template.customise: Koresha indi nyandikorugero kuri uyu mwirondoro

form.label: Ikirango
form.labelHint: Kigaragara mu myanya yo guhitamo gusa
form.taxDescription: Izigukoraho gusa; icapwa riragenzurwa kuri buri fagitire.
form.einvoiceDescription: Uko uyu mwirondoro wiyerekana muri fagitire za elegitoronike; umuhuza n’ibyangombwa byo kwinjira biri muri Igenamiterere > Fagitire za elegitoronike.
form.electronicAddressHint: Indangamuntu ya Peppol cyangwa EN 16931 y’uyu utanga, icapwa nka aderesi ya elegitoronike y’ugurisha.
form.einvoiceEnabled: Fagitire za elegitoronike zafunguwe kuri uyu mwirondoro
form.einvoiceEnabledHint: Itanga gukuramo fagitire ya elegitoronike ya GST muri JSON, Factur-X na UBL no kwandikisha IRN ku nyandiko zatanzwe zawo.
form.tdsRateHint: Ni amakuru gusa, rigaragazwa nk’igiteganyijwe gukurwaho
form.printDescription: Buri fagitire irabikoporora kandi ishobora kubihindura ukwayo.
form.emailDescription: Ibisanzwe ku mwanya wo kohereza. Ibyisubirwamo: {placeholders}
form.artworkDescription: PNG, JPEG cyangwa WebP kugeza kuri 2 MB; umukono n’ikimenyetso bigumana ubusa busobanutse.

paymentMethods.title: Uburyo bwo kwishyura
paymentMethods.description: Uko abakiriya bakwishyura. Amakuru arabitswe mu buryo bwa ngombwa kandi agashyirwa muri buri fagitire igihe itangwa.
paymentMethods.emptyDescription: Ongeraho konti ya banki, UPI ID cyangwa igikapu kugira ngo fagitire zibwire abakiriya aho bishyura.

edit.title: Hindura {name}
edit.deleteDescription: Bishoboka gusa nta fagitire cyangwa ubwishyu buburiho. Bitabaye ibyo, ububike mu bubiko.

form.name: Izina
form.detailsDescription: Abitswe mu buryo bwa ngombwa; yakoporowe muri buri fagitire igihe itangwa.
form.linesHint: Umurongo umwe kuri buri murongo, ucapwa uko wanditswe

templates.title: Inyandikorugero z’inyandiko
templates.description: Uko fagitire n’inoti z’inguzanyo zisa. Inyandiko zatanzwe zigumana inyandikorugero zatanganywe.
templates.resetDescription: Ibyo wahinduye birakurwaho; inyandiko zimaze gutangwa ntizihinduka.
templates.overridesDescription: Umwirondoro ushobora guhitamo inyandikorugero yawo ku rupapuro rwo guhindura.
templates.noOverrides: Imirondoro yose ikoresha inyandikorugero ya sisitemu.

import.jsonHint: Shyiramo dosiye yakozwe na Sohora JSON; ibyabuze bifata ibisanzwe

form.templateDescription: Esheshatu zubatswemo; ibyo uhindura hasi bikurikizwa kuri iyo uhisemo.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.character: Igezweho kandi yoroheje, inyuguti zidafite imitwe, umurongo w’ibara munsi y’umutwe.

classic.name: Classic
classic.character: Imbonerahamwe gakondo ifite imbibi, imitwe y’inyuguti zifite imitwe, igiteranyo mu kazu.

compact.name: Compact
compact.character: Imiterere yegeranye ku rutonde rurerure; inyuguti ntoya, imirongo mike itandukanya.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.character: Ituje kandi ifite umwanya: nta mirongo cyangwa uduce, amazina yoroheje, umwuka mwinshi.

letterhead.name: Letterhead
letterhead.character: Ikirango n’izina ryawe ku mukandara w’ibara cyangwa ishusho hejuru ya buri rupapuro.

modern.name: Modern
modern.character: Umutwe w’umukandara w’ibara; abagize inyandiko, umutwe w’imbonerahamwe n’igiteranyo ku ibara ryoroheje.

form.headerDescription: Umukandara w’ibara cyangwa ishusho hejuru ya buri rupapuro. Letterhead na Modern zerekana umukandara keretse uhisemo ikindi.
form.headerImageHint: PNG, JPEG cyangwa WebP kugeza kuri 2400 px z’ubugari; igera ku bugari bw’urupapuro.
form.labelsDescription: Reka umwanya ubeho ubusa kugira ngo ugumane amagambo asanzwe.

email.title: Imeri
email.description: Inyandiko zoherezwa zivuye mu mwanya wo kwandika hamwe na PDF yabitswe nk’inyongera. Igenamiterere ryo hano riruta SMTP_* mu bidukikije.
email.removeEnvTakesOver: Agaciro ka SMTP_* k’ibidukikije karahita gakoreshwa.
email.removeFallsBack: Imeri isubira ku buryo bwa porogaramu y’imeri.
email.smtpFromEnv: Ubu ivuye mu bidukikije; kubika hano biraruta.
email.smtpPasswordNote: Ijambobanga ribitswe mu buryo bwa ngombwa kandi ntirizongera kwerekanwa.
email.defaultsDescription: CC/BCC ya sisitemu yose; imirondoro y’abatanga yongeraho ibyayo.
email.sentDescription: Ibigeragezo 50 bya nyuma, harimo ibitagenze neza no kohereza ku ntoki.

smtp.passwordStored: Ribitswe kandi ririhishe; reka ubusa kugira ngo ugumane iryo

defaults.ccHint: Yongerwa kuri buri nyandiko; itandukanyijwe n’akayi

sessions.title: Ibihe bikora
sessions.description: Guhagarika igihe bisohora icyo gikoresho ako kanya.

users.title: Abakoresha
users.description: Abashobora kwinjira kuri iyi sisitemu n’ibyo bemerewe gukora.

roleHints.editor: Abakiriya, urutonde rw’ibicuruzwa, fagitire, inoti z’inguzanyo, ubwishyu, imeri

invite.title: Tumira umuntu
invite.description: Yinjira akoresheje aderesi yatumiwe (umutanga serivisi w’indangamuntu cyangwa ijambobanga) kandi agahabwa uruhare uhisemo.
invite.readyWithError: Ubutumire bwa {email} buriteguye. Imeri ntiyashoboye koherezwa ({error}); mwoherereze iyi link:
invite.readyNoSmtp: Ubutumire bwa {email} buriteguye. Nta SMTP yashyizweho; mwoherereze iyi link:

members.title: Abanyamuryango
members.description: Nyirayo umwe ukora ahora asigaye nibura.

reactivate.title: Gusubizaho {email}?
reactivate.description: Ashobora kongera kwinjira afite uruhare rwe rwa mbere.

deactivate.title: Guhagarika {email}?
deactivate.description: Ibihe byose birarangira ubu kandi ntashobora kwinjira kugeza asubijweho. Amateka ye arasigara.

data.title: Amakuru
data.description: Byose birashobora kwimurwa: ibyegeranyo nka CSV cyangwa Excel, kopi yuzuye yo kwimura, PDF z’umucungamari wawe, n’uburyo bwo gukora kopi z’inyongera bwageragejwe.

exportAll.title: Sohora amakuru yose
exportAll.description: ZIP irimo buri cyegeranyo nka CSV hamwe na <mono>data.json</mono>, kopi ifitanye isano y’imbonerahamwe zose. Imirima ihishwe (amakuru y’uburyo bwo kwishyura, ijambobanga rya SMTP) ntirimo; README iri imbere irayivuga.

exportDocuments.title: Sohora inyandiko
exportDocuments.description: PDF zose za fagitire n’inoti z’inguzanyo zatanzwe kandi zahagaritswe mu gihe runaka, zitwa n’inomero, hamwe na <mono>index.csv</mono> y’inomero, ibiteranyo na hash. PDF zibura zikorwa mu nzira.
exportDocuments.docx: Shyiramo kandi kopi ya DOCX ya buri nyandiko
exportDocuments.facturx: Shyiramo kandi kopi ya Factur-X PDF/A-3 irimo EN 16931 XML

datasets.title: Ibyegeranyo
datasets.description: Ibisohoka bimwe n’ibyo impapuro z’urutonde zitanga, hamwe n’igihe n’utanga bikurikizwa kuri byose. Ubwishyu bukoresha intera y’amatariki; abakiriya na serivisi ntibita ku gihe.

backups.title: Kopi z’inyongera
backups.notWired: Nta serivisi ya kopi z’inyongera ihujwe
backups.description: Serivisi ya Compose <mono>backup</mono> ikora kopi ya Postgres ikanabika ububiko ku gihe cya <mono>BACKUP_CRON</mono>, igumana amateka y’iminsi <mono>BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS</mono> muri volume <mono>backups</mono>, ikandika dosiye y’imiterere uru rupapuro rusoma.
backups.runNow: Kora imwe ubu, cyangwa ugarure ukoresheje dosiye ebyiri:
backups.restoreDrill: Uburyo bwo kugarura bugeragezwa muri CI na <mono>scripts/restore-drill.sh</mono>: shyiramo amakuru, kora kopi, siba, garura, hanyuma ugereranye umubare w’imirongo na hash ya PDF.

legal.metaDescription: Ukoresha iyi sisitemu: amakuru acapwa ku mpapuro z’amategeko zihuriweho.
legal.title: Amategeko
legal.description: Impapuro z’amategeko zihuriweho zicapa aya makuru. Mbere y’uko imirima yose yuzuzwa, impapuro zerekana ibisimbura byashyizwe ahabona.

operator.title: Amakuru y’ukoresha
operator.description: Wowe, nk’umuntu cyangwa sosiyete ikoresha iyi sisitemu, uri ukoresha inyandiko zivuga. Nta kintu cyoherezwa ahandi; gicapwa ku mpapuro zikurikira.

publicPages.title: Impapuro zihuriweho
publicPages.description: Zihujwe ku rupapuro rwo kwinjira, ku mwanya wo gusangira no ku itangazo rya cookies.

form.individual: Umuntu ku giti cye / nyiri ubucuruzi wenyine
form.addressHint: Icapwa mu mabwiriza no muri politiki y’ibanga nk’aderesi ya posita y’ukoresha.
form.privacyEmailHint: Aho ibisabwa by’abafite amakuru byoherezwa; ishobora kuba imeri yo kuvugana.

einvoicing.title: Fagitire za elegitoronike
einvoicing.description: Kuri buri mwirondoro w’utanga: umuhuza wandikisha fagitire za elegitoronike z’u Buhinde, n’umwirondoro w’u Burayi ukurikizwa n’ibisohoka bya Factur-X na UBL. Ibyangombwa byo kwinjira bibikwa byabitswe mu ibanga kandi ntibyongera kwerekanwa.
einvoicing.enabledHint: Fungura cyangwa funga fagitire za elegitoronike kuri buri mwirondoro muri Igenamiterere > Imirondoro.

india.title: U Buhinde (fagitire ya elegitoronike ya GST, IRN)
india.description: IRN yandikwa binyuze ku muhuza watoranyijwe hano; umuhuza w’intoki yakira igisubizo cy’urubuga mu ntoki.
india.nicUnverified: Umuhuza wa NIC akurikiza API yasohotse kandi yageragejwe gusa ku makuru yafashwe; ntiyigeze isuzumwa kuri sandbox nyayo kugeza ibyangombwa byo kwinjira bitanzwe.
india.publicKeyHint: Rukure kuri portal umaze kwinjira; rurinda amakuru y’ibanga yoherezwa kuri IRP.
india.publicKeyStored: Cyabitswe; reka ubusa kugira ngo ugikomeze.
india.secretStored: Cyabitswe mu ibanga; reka ubusa ngo kigumeho.

eu.title: Uburayi (Factur-X, UBL)
eu.description: EN 16931 ni wo mwirondoro wonyine muri iyi verisiyo; gukuramo Factur-X na UBL biwukoresha.

einvoicing.save: Bika igenamiterere rya fagitire za elegitoronike

api.description: Imfunguzo z’inyandiko za porogaramu, SDK n’abakiriya ba MCP. Urufunguzo rushobora gukora ibyo uruhare rwawe rwemera gusa; rwerekanwa rimwe.

create.title: Kora urufunguzo
create.description: Rwohereze nka <mono>Authorization: Bearer okv_…</mono>. Ntirushyire mu nkomoko ya porogaramu cyangwa mu biganiro; urwihanike hasi niba rwasohotse.

keys.activeCount: {count, plural, =1 {# rufunguzo rukora.} other {# imfunguzo zikora.}}

examples.title: Ingero
examples.description: Simbuza <mono>$OKINVO_KEY</mono> urufunguzo. REST API ifite verisiyo, inyandiko yayo ya OpenAPI (<mono>/api/openapi.json</mono>), TypeScript SDK na seriveri ya MCP biraza mu mirimo ikurikira ya gahunda ya v1.1; aho kureba imiterere birakora uyu munsi.
examples.rateLimit: Ibyifuzo birenga igipimo bisubizwa 429 hamwe n’umutwe wa <mono>Retry-After</mono> (ibyifuzo 120 ku munota kuri buri rufunguzo). Ububasha bw’urufunguzo bugarukira ku ruhare rwa nyirarwo rw’ubu.

scopes.documentsRead: Kuramo PDF n’amakopi ya DOCX yabitswe

step1.title: Tubwire kuri wowe

step1.emailHint: Indangamuntu yawe yo kwinjira. Ishobora guhindurwa nyuma mu Igenamiterere → Umutekano.
step1.currencyHint: Rikoreshwa ku mirondoro mishya no ku mbonerahamwe kugeza umwirondoro ubayeho.

step2.title: Uzakoresha ute okinvo?
step2.subtitle: Ibisanzwe gusa ni byo bihinduka; nta kintu gifungiranwe.

taxQuestion.other: Ufite inomero yo kwiyandikisha mu misoro yo gucapa kuri fagitire?

step3.title: Byose biteguye
step3.body: Ubutaha, kora umwirondoro wawe wa mbere w’utanga: izina, aderesi n’amakuru y’imisoro bicapwa kuri fagitire zawe. Twuzuje ibyo watubwiye.

cookieNotice.label: Itangazo rya cookies
cookieNotice.body: Dukoresha cookies z’ingenzi cyane gusa: igihe cyawe n’ibyo wahisemo byo kwerekana. Nta isesengura, nta gukurikirana.

legalChrome.operatorNotice: okinvo ni porogaramu yikoreshwa n’ubyifuza; ukoresha iyi sisitemu ni we ushinzwe uko ikoreshwa.

notFound.title: Nta kintu kiri kuri iyi aderesi
notFound.body: Link ishobora kuba yarashaje, cyangwa inyandiko yerekezagaho ntiyigeze itangwa.

forbidden.title: Iyi konti ntishobora kubikora
forbidden.body: Uruhare rwawe ntirubyemera. Saba nyirayo uburenganzira, cyangwa winjire na konti ibufite.

error.title: Hari ibitagenze neza
error.body: Nta kintu iki cyifuzo cyahinduye. Ongera ugerageze; niba bikomeje, igitabo cya seriveri gifite amakuru arambuye.

appNotFound.title: Ntibyabonetse
appNotFound.body: Iyi nyandiko ntiriho, cyangwa yasibwe ukiyireba.

validation.invalidDate: igomba kuba itariki yo ku kalendari mu buryo bwa YYYY-MM-DD
validation.charset: Inyuguti zisanzwe z’akanyamashusho k’ibyuma gusa ni zo zemewe.

verify.metaDescription: Reba ko inyemezabuguzi cyangwa inyemezabwishyu yatanzwe n'uyohereje kandi ko itahinduwe.

verify.rateLimited: Ibigenzura byinshi cyane biturutse kuri iyi aderesi. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y’umunota.

notFound.title: Nta nyandiko nk’iyo
notFound.body: Iyi link ntihuye n’inyandiko yatanzwe iyo ari yo yose. Genzura kode ya QR cyangwa link wahawe, cyangwa uvugane n’utanga.

verify.voided: Iyi nyandiko yahagaritswe n’utanga kandi ntigifite agaciro.

storedCopies.title: Amakopi yabitswe
storedCopies.description: SHA-256 ya buri verisiyo ya PDF utanga abitse. Hitamo kopi yawe kugira ngo uyigereranye muri mushakisha yawe: nta kintu cyoherezwa.

check.label: Genzura kopi yawe
check.match: Kopi yawe ihuye neza na verisiyo {version}.
check.mismatch: Kopi yawe ntihuye n’iyo verisiyo yabitswe.

viewer.title: Inyandiko isangiwe
viewer.metaDescription: Inyandiko wasangiwe: yirebere kuri interineti ukuremo PDF.
viewer.rateLimited: Ibyifuzo byinshi cyane biturutse kuri iyi aderesi. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y’umunota.

unavailable.title: Iyi link ntiboneka
unavailable.body: Ishobora kuba yararangiye cyangwa yarahagaritswe n’utanga. Musabe indi nshya.

viewer.lockedBody: Iyi nyandiko irinzwe n’ijambobanga. Andika ijambobanga utanga yaguhaye.
viewer.protectedPdf: PDF ifungurwa n’ijambobanga rimwe. Irashobora gusomwa no gucapwa; kuyikoporora no kuyihindura birafunzwe.

password.label: Ijambobanga
password.limited: Ibigeragezo byinshi cyane. Tegereza iminota cumi n’itanu hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

dialog.title: Sangira iyi nyandiko
dialog.description: Uwo ari we wese ufite link ashobora kuyireba no kuyikuramo kugeza irangiye cyangwa uyihagaritse. Ijambobanga ririnda na PDF ubwayo: ifungurwa n’ijambobanga kandi irashobora gusomwa no gucapwa, ntishobora guhindurwa cyangwa gukoporowa.
